revenue.source: P&G FY2026 Annual Report/10-K (accession 0000080424-26-000103), Consolidated Statements of Earnings

operating_income.source: P&G FY2026 10-K (0000080424-26-000103), Statements of Earnings, operating income

d_and_a.source: P&G FY2026 10-K, Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows

capex.source: P&G FY2026 10-K, Cash Flows, capital expenditures (shown as outflow; entered positive)

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY26 growth 3.3%, FY25 0.3%; organic growth ~2-4% with pricing/volume; fades to 3% toward long-run staples growth.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2026 margin 22.7% (19,748/87,032), FY2025 24.3%, FY2024 22.1%; held near FY26 level, slightly below for cost/tariff pressure.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approx. P&G effective tax rate ~21-22% in recent years; not verified against filing in this session.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: P&G guides capital spending 4.5-5.5% of FY2027 net sales (Q4 FY26 release); FY26 actual 5.1%.

wacc.source: Assumption: low-beta (~0.5-0.6) staples, risk-free ~4.3%, ERP ~5%, modest leverage; ~7%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run nominal growth below GDP/inflation; staples mature.

net_debt.source: P&G FY2026 balance sheet at June 30, 2026: debt due within one year 11,296 + long-term debt 22,842 = 34,138, minus cash 9,942; no separate short-term investments found.

diluted_shares.source: P&G FY2026 Statements of Earnings / Q4 FY26 release: diluted weighted average common shares outstanding (millions)
